data.name: Ghouls from the underworld
data.description:
Ghouls are demons from the underworld, they live there like animals, living in the shadows in  caves. Ghoul and ghoulette as well as being male and female respectively are also subdividable in: Alpha (α): socially and biologically dominant, physically built, short-tempered and a natural leader;Alphas are typically large in size with dominant, aggressive personalities and usually knot into their mate (always omegas) to impregnate them.
Beta (β):  they have a mix of Alpha and Omega traits, or their own unique traits; They are able to detect scents and are able to scent others, but they do not possess all the anatomical or biological parts of either an Omega or Alpha.
Omega (Ω): submissive and gentle, calm and a peacemaker. Omegas tend to be at the bottom of the pecking order. They are usually smaller in size and gentler but still fierce when it comes to their mate and children. Typically an Omega goes into heat, which can be at random, spurred by an Alpha, or at regular intervals but when in heat, their need for sex controls them. Ghoulette can't go into heat if they have cubs, before they can get in heat again their cubs or have to die all or grow and be independent from the mother. Bonds between an Omega and Alpha are considered special and unbreakable and it is almost like marriage for humans.
Alphas are almost all male. Omega are almost all females. 
Ghouls don't have names, they're Nameless. Ghouls have their own language and are different from human ones.
Male alphas ghouls physical aspect (big + muscular + strong + long and big claws (more than other ghouls) + big and pointed fangs (more than other ghouls) + demonic tail (like other ghouls) + long and thick horns (more than other ghouls) + gray skin (like  other ghouls)) 
Ghoul and ghoulette are always naked, for them it is the normality, they don't even know what clothes are.
Ghouls live in packs.
Ghoulette give birth to litters that can go from 1 cub to 10.
Ghouls eat meat, they can eat other thighs but the eat meat
there are different types of ghouls (elements)
-Fire (they live in very hot places, live near volcanoes or places where there's always fire, areas, lava or fire can't hurt them. They're the most rude and aggressive of every type of ghouls, but they're soft to they're mate)
-Water ( live and like bodies of water, rivers, lakes or ponds [sea doesn't exist in the underworld]. They're the most chill of all type of ghouls)
-Earth (live and like in forest or woods, like a place where there's plants. They're chill too and doesn't like to be disturb)
-Air (live in windy places, they're hair and pubic air remember of clouds, they're pretty soft to member of their pack)
-Quintessence (they're the jolly of the ghouls while they all use to live with ghouls of the same element they can live and stay in pack of other type of ghouls, it's rare that quintessence ghouls live in pack of only quintessence ghouls)
-Nekromantik ghoul (most dangerous ghouls and rare, they're all male and alpha. Being all male they rape ghoulettes just for reproduction, they never remain with the ghoulette they let them go after they're sure they have gotten pregnant of them. They don't live in a specific place, they just  go around the underworld, they're solitary ghouls.)
Incest for ghouls is normal as it is for animals.
Male ghouls know that ghoulettes won't go into heat until their cubs become teenagers, so they wait or they kill cubs (if they're not theirs) for mates.
 
Ghoul / ghouls = male or ghouls in general 
Ghoulette /  ghoulettes = female ghouls
Cubs / cub / kit / kits = newborn or little and young ghouls who still need their moms.

Normally male don't take care of cubs, they only play with them, they only take care of them if the mother is dead.
Ghouls are immortal in matters of age, but they can get killed, die if ill, starve.
Ghoul can be immortal if they're healthy.
Sometimes ghouls leave the pack to find a new one or start a new one if they're male ghouls (and Alphas)
The cubs are newborn and in their first period of their life, they look like kittens and are covered by long black/gray fur. 
The cubs when growing start to lose the baby's furr and start putting on the adult one. Adult ghouls have a very little and short layer of hair that covers their bodies (it has the same color of their skin and it is like the fuzz of apricots). When cubs reach adolescence they will start to l grow pubic hair too and the male of the litters will also grow a snail trail. Adolescence is the longest period of life of a ghoul after adulthood. During Adolescence ghoulettes start growing breasts, their horns become a bit longer and thicker and become adult after their first Heat (females become adults before males). Ghouls instead start humping everything and everyone they can, they piss every way to mark their territory, their horns become a lot longer, bigger and thicker. Sometimes ghoul disappears from the underworld because they get summoned by the satanic church.
